_comment: Sample only — one verse, in the shape the Read & Translate screen consumes. Text is SBLGNT-style (verify exact SBLGNT punctuation/text when replacing this sample); translations are public domain (KJV/YLT/WEB) — never add copyrighted translations here.

_schema.id: verse id, used as the readingHistory key
_schema.words: ordered array of { text, lemma, known } — 'known' should be computed at runtime from which lexicon items the learner has studied, not hardcoded; included here only for the static sample
